name: crouton
description: Menu-bar app for macOS: local Whisper transcription → Obsidian note → local LLM summary with action items.

scripts.install-app: npm run pack && (pkill -f 'Crouton.app/Contents/MacOS/Crouton' || true) && rm -rf /Applications/Crouton.app && cp -R dist/mac-arm64/Crouton.app /Applications/ && open /Applications/Crouton.app

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Crouton uses the microphone to transcribe meetings on-device.
